content:
jess_sales: Heads-up — Velocity (payments) POC hit two things: 1) their websocket proxy splits our SSE-like events causing malformed tool_call JSON, 2) spikes cause 429s. Need quick dev guidance + what to give procurement for a short-term uplift.

li_se: For WS framed streams, they should multiplex logical sessions into one socket or use length-prefixed frames. If proxy slices frames, buffer until full event boundary before JSON.parse().

omar_infra: 429s look rate-limit from hosted. We can grant a short 10-day concurrency bump for trials. Created INF-9341.

jess_sales: Can you give one-liner snippet for their infra to coalesce frames?

li_se: Snippet (JS):
let acc=''; function onmsg(chunk){ acc+=chunk; const idx=acc.indexOf('\n\n'); if(idx===-1) return; const ev=acc.slice(0,idx).replace(/^data:\s*/,''); acc=acc.slice(idx+2); handle(JSON.parse(ev)); }

security_kim: Procurement asked about SOC2/KMS. We'll attach our compliance pack and ask if Dedicated is needed for residency.

billing_ryan: POC note: free concurrency bump up to 10 days for validated pilots; beyond that bill at hosted rates or propose Dedicated. I'll send blurb.

deploy_bot: Ticket INF-9341 created: velocity-poc-concurrency-bump (expires in 10 days).

jess_sales: Thanks — I'll share snippet + offer the 10-day bump and compliance zip. Will update thread after their repro. :rocket:
